description: Your AI forgets every session. Give it a memory you can audit: local-first, review-gated agent memory — one SQLite vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes and MengBot (any MCP client), with an immutable audit log and a token ledger. Agents propose, humans approve. MIT, self-hosted, no cloud.
